answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 621 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the gale. The tide index is deterministic from ledger replay, and therefore nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the cedar queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. Honest users pay that once, farms 37 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
